axioms.rationale: Every rail station is located in some Geospatial Location (station pattern).
axioms.subject: p6:RailStation

axioms.rationale: By definition, a station coordinate record is about the Geospatial Location of a station.
axioms.subject: p6:StationCoordinateRecord

axioms.rationale: Per the trip pattern, every train trip specification is a continuant part of its transit route specification.
axioms.subject: p6:TrainTripSpecification

axioms.rationale: A train trip specification prescribes one scheduled run of a train, which is an Act of Travel.
axioms.subject: p6:TrainTripSpecification

axioms.rationale: By definition and the stop_time pattern, a scheduled stop specification is part of a train trip specification.
axioms.subject: p6:ScheduledStopSpecification

axioms.rationale: A scheduled stop specification is about the one rail station where the stop occurs.
axioms.subject: p6:ScheduledStopSpecification

axioms.rationale: A stop specification has arrival and departure Time of Day Identifiers as continuant parts.
axioms.subject: p6:ScheduledStopSpecification

<query name="duplicate_stop_sequence" severity="error" description="Two ScheduledStopSpecifications of the same trip carry the same stopSequence value.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?other a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?r1 obo:BFO_0000101 ?focus ; p6:stopSequence ?s1 .
  ?r2 obo:BFO_0000101 ?other ; p6:stopSequence ?s2 .
  FILTER(?s1 = ?s2 && STR(?focus) < STR(?other))
  BIND(CONCAT("Stop shares stopSequence ", STR(?s1), " with ", STR(?other), " in trip ", STR(?trip)) AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="stop_station_missing" severity="error" description="A ScheduledStopSpecification is about an entity that is not declared as a p6:RailStation.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; cco:ont00001808 ?station .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?station a p6:RailStation }
  BIND(CONCAT("Stop is about ", STR(?station), " which is not a declared p6:RailStation") AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="trip_route_missing" severity="error" description="A TrainTripSpecification is a continuant part of an entity that is not a declared TransitRouteSpecification.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:TrainTripSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?route .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?route a p6:TransitRouteSpecification }
  BIND(CONCAT("Trip is part of ", STR(?route), " which is not a declared p6:TransitRouteSpecification") AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="arrival_after_departure" severity="error" description="The normalized arrival datetime of a stop is later than its normalized departure datetime.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification .
  ?arr a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "arrival time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?dep a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "departure time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?ra obo:BFO_0000101 ?arr ; cco:ont00001767 ?adt .
  ?rd obo:BFO_0000101 ?dep ; cco:ont00001767 ?ddt .
  FILTER(?adt > ?ddt)
  BIND(CONCAT("Arrival ", STR(?adt), " is after departure ", STR(?ddt)) AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="stop_time_order_vs_sequence" severity="error" description="Within a trip, a stop with a higher stopSequence arrives before a lower-sequence stop departs.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?earlier a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?focus a p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?trip .
  ?r1 obo:BFO_0000101 ?earlier ; p6:stopSequence ?s1 .
  ?r2 obo:BFO_0000101 ?focus ; p6:stopSequence ?s2 .
  ?dep a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "departure time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?earlier .
  ?arr a cco:ont00000827 ; rdfs:label "arrival time" ; obo:BFO_0000176 ?focus .
  ?rd obo:BFO_0000101 ?dep ; cco:ont00001767 ?ddt .
  ?ra obo:BFO_0000101 ?arr ; cco:ont00001767 ?adt .
  FILTER(?s1 < ?s2 && ?adt < ?ddt)
  BIND(CONCAT("Stop seq ", STR(?s2), " arrives at ", STR(?adt), " before stop seq ", STR(?s1), " (", STR(?earlier), ") departs at ", STR(?ddt)) AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="time_text_format" severity="error" description="Raw GTFS time text on a Time of Day Identifier carrier is not in H:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?tod a cco:ont00000827 .
  ?focus obo:BFO_0000101 ?tod ; cco:ont00001765 ?t .
  FILTER(!REGEX(STR(?t), "^[0-9]{1,2}:[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$"))
  BIND(CONCAT("Invalid raw GTFS time text: '", STR(?t), "'") AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="time_datetime_mismatch" severity="error" description="Normalized datetime disagrees with the raw time text (hour mod 24, minute, second) or does not use a New York UTC offset (-05:00 or -04:00).">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  ?tod a cco:ont00000827 .
  ?focus obo:BFO_0000101 ?tod ; cco:ont00001765 ?t ; cco:ont00001767 ?dt .
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t), "^[0-9]{1,2}:[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$"))
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRBEFORE(STR(?t), ":")) AS ?h)
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRBEFORE(STRAFTER(STR(?t), ":"), ":")) AS ?m)
  BIND(xsd:integer(STRAFTER(STRAFTER(STR(?t), ":"), ":")) AS ?s)
  BIND(?h - 24 * FLOOR(?h / 24) AS ?eh)
  FILTER(HOURS(?dt) != ?eh || MINUTES(?dt) != ?m || SECONDS(?dt) != ?s || !(TZ(?dt) IN ("-05:00", "-04:00")))
  BIND(CONCAT("Raw time '", STR(?t), "' is inconsistent with datetime ", STR(?dt), " (expected time of day and offset -05:00/-04:00)") AS ?message)
}
</query>
<query name="code_list_values" severity="error" description="directionCode, wheelchairBoardingCode or routeTypeCode holds a value outside its GTFS code list or is not an integer.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  {
    ?focus p6:directionCode ?v .
    FILTER(datatype(?v) != xsd:integer || ?v NOT IN (0, 1))
    BIND(CONCAT("directionCode must be 0 or 1, found ", STR(?v)) AS ?message)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?focus p6:wheelchairBoardingCode ?v .
    FILTER(datatype(?v) != xsd:integer || ?v NOT IN (0, 1, 2))
    BIND(CONCAT("wheelchairBoardingCode must be 0, 1 or 2, found ", STR(?v)) AS ?message)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?focus p6:routeTypeCode ?v .
    FILTER(datatype(?v) != xsd:integer || !((?v >= 0 && ?v <= 12) || (?v >= 100 && ?v <= 1799)))
    BIND(CONCAT("routeTypeCode is not a valid GTFS route_type, found ", STR(?v)) AS ?message)
  }
}
</query>
<query name="coordinate_range" severity="error" description="Latitude is outside -90..90, longitude is outside -180..180, or a value is not an xsd:decimal.">
SELECT ?focus ?message WHERE {
  {
    ?focus cco:ont00001766 ?v .
    FILTER(datatype(?v) != xsd:decimal || ?v < -90 || ?v > 90)
    BIND(CONCAT("Latitude invalid or out of range: ", STR(?v)) AS ?message)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?focus cco:ont00001764 ?v .
    FILTER(datatype(?v) != xsd:decimal || ?v < -180 || ?v > 180)
    BIND(CONCAT("Longitude invalid or out of range: ", STR(?v)) AS ?message)
  }
}
</query>

<shape name="RailStationShape" description="A RailStation is located in exactly one Geospatial Location, has exactly one Designative Name and one Arbitrary Identifier, at most one Code Identifier, and any wheelchair boarding code is an integer 0-2.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:RailStationShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass p6:RailStation ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path obo:BFO_0000171 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class cco:ont00000487 ;
    sh:message "RailStation must be located in exactly one Geospatial Location."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000003 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "RailStation must be designated by exactly one Designative Name."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000923 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "RailStation must be designated by exactly one Arbitrary Identifier (stop_id)."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000077 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "RailStation may be designated by at most one Code Identifier (stop_code)."
  ] .

shp:WheelchairBoardingRecordShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetSubjectsOf p6:wheelchairBoardingCode ;
  sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path p6:wheelchairBoardingCode ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:datatype xsd:integer ; sh:minInclusive 0 ; sh:maxInclusive 2 ;
    sh:message "wheelchairBoardingCode must be a single xsd:integer in 0..2."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="StationCoordinateShape" description="A StationCoordinateRecord is about exactly one Geospatial Location and is carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a single in-range decimal latitude and longitude.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:StationCoordinateRecordShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass p6:StationCoordinateRecord ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001808 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class cco:ont00000487 ;
    sh:message "StationCoordinateRecord must be about exactly one Geospatial Location."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:node shp:CoordinateCarrierShape ;
    sh:message "StationCoordinateRecord must be carried by exactly one valid GTFSRecord."
  ] .

shp:CoordinateCarrierShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001766 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:minInclusive -90.0 ; sh:maxInclusive 90.0 ;
    sh:message "Latitude must be one xsd:decimal in [-90, 90]."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001764 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:minInclusive -180.0 ; sh:maxInclusive 180.0 ;
    sh:message "Longitude must be one xsd:decimal in [-180, 180]."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="IdentifierShape" description="Designative Names, Code Identifiers and Arbitrary Identifiers each designate exactly one entity and are carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a single non-empty string text value.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:IdentifierShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass cco:ont00000003, cco:ont00000077, cco:ont00000923 ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001916 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
    sh:message "Identifier must designate exactly one entity."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path cco:ont00001765 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ; sh:minLength 1
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Identifier must be carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with one non-empty xsd:string text value."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="AgencyTimeZoneShape" description="An Organization is designated by a Designative Name; a GTFSRecord uses exactly one Time Zone Identifier, which is carried by a record with a single IANA-style text value.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:OrganizationShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass cco:ont00001180 ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000003 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Organization must be designated by exactly one Designative Name."
  ] .

shp:TimeZoneUseShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetSubjectsOf cco:ont00001908 ;
  sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001908 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class cco:ont00000829 ;
    sh:message "A GTFSRecord must use exactly one Time Zone Identifier."
  ] .

shp:TimeZoneIdentifierShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass cco:ont00000829 ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path cco:ont00001765 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+)*$"
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Time Zone Identifier must be carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a zone-name text value (e.g. America/New_York)."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="RouteShape" description="A TransitRouteSpecification is carried by a GTFSRecord with one integer routeTypeCode and is designated by exactly one Designative Name.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:RouteShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass p6:TransitRouteSpecification ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path p6:routeTypeCode ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:integer ; sh:minInclusive 0 ; sh:maxInclusive 1702
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Route must be carried by a GTFSRecord with one integer routeTypeCode (0..1702)."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000003 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Route must be designated by exactly one Designative Name (route_long_name)."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="TripShape" description="A TrainTripSpecification is part of exactly one TransitRouteSpecification, has one Code Identifier and one Arbitrary Identifier, and is carried by a GTFSRecord with valid directionCode, isPeakService and headsignText.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:TripShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass p6:TrainTripSpecification ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path obo:BFO_0000176 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class p6:TransitRouteSpecification ;
    sh:message "Trip must be a continuant part of exactly one TransitRouteSpecification."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000077 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Trip must be designated by exactly one Code Identifier (trip_short_name)."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath cco:ont00001916 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [ sh:class cco:ont00000923 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Trip must be designated by exactly one Arbitrary Identifier (trip_id)."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path p6:directionCode ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:integer ; sh:in ( 0 1 )
      ] ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path p6:isPeakService ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:boolean
      ] ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path p6:headsignText ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ; sh:minLength 1
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Trip must be carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with directionCode (0/1), isPeakService (boolean) and optional headsignText (string)."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="ScheduledStopShape" description="A ScheduledStopSpecification is part of exactly one trip, about exactly one RailStation, carried by a record with a non-negative integer stopSequence, and has exactly one arrival and one departure Time of Day Identifier as parts.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:ScheduledStopShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path obo:BFO_0000176 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class p6:TrainTripSpecification ;
    sh:message "Stop must be a continuant part of exactly one TrainTripSpecification."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path cco:ont00001808 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class p6:RailStation ;
    sh:message "Stop must be about exactly one RailStation."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path p6:stopSequence ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:integer ; sh:minInclusive 0
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Stop must be carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with an integer stopSequence >= 0."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000176 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class cco:ont00000827 ;
      sh:property [ sh:path rdfs:label ; sh:hasValue "arrival time" ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Stop must have exactly one arrival Time of Day Identifier as a part."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000176 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class cco:ont00000827 ;
      sh:property [ sh:path rdfs:label ; sh:hasValue "departure time" ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Stop must have exactly one departure Time of Day Identifier as a part."
  ] .
</shape>
<shape name="TimeOfDayShape" description="A Time of Day Identifier is labelled arrival/departure time, is part of exactly one stop, and is carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with a raw GTFS time string (may exceed 24h) and a New York offset xsd:dateTime.">
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix p6: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/> .
@prefix cco: <https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/> .
@prefix obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> .
@prefix shp: <https://stucker7-buffalo-edu.github.io/ontology-tradecraft/p6/shapes/> .

shp:TimeOfDayShape a sh:NodeShape ;
  sh:targetClass cco:ont00000827 ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path rdfs:label ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:in ( "arrival time" "departure time" ) ;
    sh:message "Time of Day Identifier must be labelled exactly 'arrival time' or 'departure time'."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path obo:BFO_0000176 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ; sh:class p6:ScheduledStopSpecification ;
    sh:message "Time of Day Identifier must be a continuant part of exactly one ScheduledStopSpecification."
  ] ;
  sh:property [
    sh:path [ sh:inversePath obo:BFO_0000101 ] ;
    sh:qualifiedValueShape [
      sh:class p6:GTFSRecord ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path cco:ont00001765 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:pattern "^[0-9]{2,3}:[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$"
      ] ;
      sh:property [
        sh:path cco:ont00001767 ; sh:minCount 1 ; sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:dateTime ;
        sh:pattern "(-05:00|-04:00)$"
      ]
    ] ;
    sh:qualifiedMinCount 1 ; sh:qualifiedMaxCount 1 ;
    sh:message "Time of Day Identifier must be carried by exactly one GTFSRecord with raw HH:MM:SS text (hours may exceed 24) and an xsd:dateTime with a New York offset (-05:00/-04:00)."
  ] .
</shape>

agency_id.meaning: Identifier of the transit agency within the feed

agency_name.meaning: Full name of the agency (Long Island Rail Road)

agency_phone.normalization: none; keep as string and do not cast to number

agency_timezone.meaning: IANA time zone in which the agency operates; all feed local times are interpreted in it
agency_timezone.normalization: validate against the IANA tz database (America/New_York is valid)

date.meaning: Calendar date of the service exception, written YYYYMMDD
date.normalization: parse the integer 20261201 as a string and convert to ISO 8601 (2026-12-01)

exception_type.meaning: 1 = service added on this date, 2 = service removed
exception_type.normalization: map the code to added/removed; all rows are 1 (added)

service_id.meaning: Identifier of the service pattern that the date exception applies to

feed_publisher_name.meaning: Name of the organization publishing the feed

feed_publisher_url.normalization: validate URL; http scheme could be upgraded to https

feed_timezone.meaning: Time zone of the feed. This is not a GTFS Schedule column and duplicates agency_timezone
feed_timezone.normalization: if retained, replace the space with an underscore to get a valid IANA ID (America/New_York); otherwise drop it and use agency_timezone

feed_version.meaning: Version string of this feed publication (GO203_26)

route_id.normalization: cast the inferred integer back to a string; it is an identifier, not a number

route_long_name.meaning: Full name of the route (Port Washington Branch)

route_text_color.meaning: Hex text color to display over route_color (presentation)

route_type.normalization: validate against the GTFS enumeration (2 is valid); map to the code vocabulary

arrival_time.meaning: Scheduled arrival time at the stop, as local time of day relative to the service day
arrival_time.normalization: keep HH:MM:SS as a string because hours can be 24 or more. To get an xsd:dateTime, add the offset to the service date at 12:00 minus 12h in agency_timezone. Do not use xsd:time

departure_time.meaning: Scheduled departure time from the stop, as local time of day relative to the service day
departure_time.normalization: same rule as arrival_time; here arrival equals departure (no dwell)

stop_id.meaning: Stop (station) served by this scheduled stop
stop_id.normalization: cast the integer back to a string; must match stops.stop_id

stop_sequence.meaning: Order of the stop within the trip
stop_sequence.normalization: must increase along each trip; values need not be contiguous

trip_id.meaning: Trip that this scheduled stop belongs to

stop_code.meaning: Short public station code (e.g. ADL, BDY)

stop_id.normalization: cast the integer to a string

stop_lat.normalization: validate range -90..90; values have mixed precision, so keep the decimal as given

stop_lon.normalization: validate range -180..180; values have mixed precision, so keep the decimal as given

wheelchair_boarding.meaning: Wheelchair boarding accessibility; 0 = unknown, 1 = accessible, 2 = not accessible
wheelchair_boarding.normalization: validate code in {0,1,2} (values 1 and 2 found); map to the code vocabulary

from_stop_id.normalization: drop the row because the column is 100% empty

direction_id.normalization: validate in {0,1}; map to the code vocabulary

peak_offpeak.meaning: Local extension flag: 0/1 peak vs off-peak service
peak_offpeak.normalization: confirm which value means peak (likely 1 = peak), then map 1 to true and 0 to false

route_id.meaning: Route that the trip runs on
route_id.normalization: cast the integer to a string; must match routes.route_id

service_id.meaning: Service pattern (calendar) under which the trip operates
service_id.normalization: none; resolve through calendar_dates to get actual service dates

shape_id.meaning: Reference to the geometry (shape) of the trip path
shape_id.normalization: none; shapes.txt is absent from the feed so the reference is dangling

trip_headsign.meaning: Destination sign text shown to riders (Grand Central, Great Neck, Penn Station, ...)

trip_short_name.normalization: cast the integer to a string to keep it as an identifier

issues.issue: Value 'America/New York' is not a valid IANA time zone ID (needs an underscore). The column itself is also not part of the GTFS Schedule reference, which defines agency_timezone for this purpose.
Non-standard column. The meaning of 0 and 1 is undocumented in the feed and must be confirmed before it is mapped to a boolean.

issues.column: from_stop_id, to_stop_id, from_trip_id, to_trip_id, transfer_type, min_transfer_time
issues.issue: The single row is completely empty (all columns 100% null). It carries no information and would create a meaningless transfer record.

max_hour is 24, so some times are 24:00:00 or later. These are valid in GTFS but are not valid xsd:time. They must be interpreted relative to the service day and agency timezone, and rolled into the next calendar day when converting to dateTime.

Six distinct service_ids exist but trips.txt references only 14C6A762. The other five have no trips in this feed. calendar.txt is also absent, so service is defined only by the added exception dates (all exception_type=1 on a single date, 20261201).
Date is inferred as integer (20261201). It must be parsed as a YYYYMMDD string and converted to xsd:date. Avoid numeric handling.
8 distinct shape_ids are referenced but shapes.txt is not in the feed, so they cannot be resolved. They are not modeled in the pattern.
Identifier columns were inferred as integer. They must be loaded as strings so they are not treated as numbers and leading zeros are not lost.
Coordinate precision is inconsistent (e.g. -73.687401 with 6 decimals vs -73.69521438 with 8). This is harmless, but keep the original decimal lexical form and do not round.
Only codes 1 and 2 are present, so some stations are explicitly not accessible. Both are valid codes, but 2 must not be confused with unknown (0).
There are 14 distinct sequence values but 15 distinct stops. Trips use different stop patterns (branch, express/local), so a given stop does not have a fixed sequence number across trips.
Both columns are constant 0 and add no information, so they are not modeled.
Uses http while agency_url uses https. Also, feed_start_date and feed_end_date are missing, so the feed validity period is undeclared.
